description: This source file defines the ScreenController class, responsible for managing a web-based UI within an iOS application. It handles navigation, state updates, debugging tools, snapshotting, and URL validation for embedded web views, with an emphasis on rendering custom canvas content and handling deep links.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class managing a web-based UI canvas, handling navigation, state management, debugging, and snapshotting within an iOS app.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a specified URL string, with optional trust for A2UI actions, and handles URL validation and loading.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current web view based on the current URL string, handling local file URLs and remote URLs.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets to the default canvas by clearing the URL and associated trust state.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay and updates the web view accordingly.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug title and subtitle for display in the web view.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the stored JSON state for the home canvas and applies it to the web view.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Injects JavaScript to render the home state into the web view.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until the A2UI interface in the web view is ready or times out.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the web view as a PNG, encoded in base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the web view in the specified image format and quality, returning a base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotImage
methods.description: Internally captures a UIImage snapshot of the current web view with optional width constraint.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Associates a WKWebView with this controller and reloads state.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches a WKWebView if it’s currently attached.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Checks whether a URL matches the trusted canvas UI URL(s).

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Parses the body of an A2UI action from various formats into a dictionary.
